prompt: I'd like a command that shows who last changed the line I'm on (git blame), with the commit message, in a small float next to the cursor. Bind it to space g b please.
setup: G="git -c user.name=Bench -c user.email=bench@example.com"; mv main.rs main.final && printf 'fn main() {}\n' > main.rs && git add -A && $G commit -qm Start && mv main.final main.rs && git add -A && git -c user.name='Ada Bench' -c user.email=ada@example.com commit -qm 'Count words, not lines'
luau_check: local greed = require('@greed') local cmd = greed.keymap.resolve('space g b') if not cmd then return 'nothing on space g b' end greed.run(cmd) return 'ran ' .. cmd
for _, b in require('@greed').buffers() do if string.find(b:text(), 'Count words, not lines', 1, true) then return true end end return 'no float with the commit message'
